memories_scope_check.name: memories_scope_check
memories_scope_check.value: ("memories"."scope" = 'workspace' and "memories"."table_id" is null and "memories"."agent_id" is null) or ("memories"."scope" = 'table' and "memories"."table_id" is not null and "memories"."agent_id" is null) or ("memories"."scope" = 'agent' and "memories"."agent_id" is not null and "memories"."table_id" is null)

widgets_target_check.name: widgets_target_check
widgets_target_check.value: ("widgets"."type" = 'workflow-form' and "widgets"."workflow_id" is not null and "widgets"."trigger_id" is null and "widgets"."table_id" is null and "widgets"."config" is null) or ("widgets"."type" = 'trigger-form' and "widgets"."trigger_id" is not null and "widgets"."workflow_id" is null and "widgets"."table_id" is null and "widgets"."config" is null) or ("widgets"."type" in ('grid', 'table') and "widgets"."workflow_id" is null and "widgets"."trigger_id" is null and "widgets"."table_id" is not null and "widgets"."config" is not null)
